name: pyautogui_mouse_drag
description:
Drag the mouse from an optional start position to (x, y) with the button held down.

If from_x/from_y are omitted, dragging starts at the current cursor position. Returns the final cursor position.

from_x.description: Start X coordinate (omit to drag from current position)

button.description: Mouse button to hold during drag (default: left)
